criteria.criterion: Use only the supplied Crossref response (message object fields)
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: the agent did not import external metadata. Although the agent missed that publisher is visible, that is an extraction omission (handled in criterion 2), not a violation of the 'use only supplied Crossref response' constraint.

Baseline gave credit for noting inability, but the agent did not actually record the title or explicitly mark it unavailable in message.title; it only claimed the snapshot was truncated. With no DOM support for a title value and no proper 'not present in message.title' reporting, award 0.
Critical omission/contradiction: publisher is explicitly visible in DOM but the agent failed to record it. Score should be reduced to 0.

No DOM evidence provides message.published.date-parts, so the date cannot be extracted. However, the agent did not explicitly report 'published date not present in message.published.date-parts'—only that it was not visible due to truncation. Award partial credit for not fabricating and for correctly not using other date fields, but not full credit because the required reporting/recording wasn’t done.

As with published date: agent did not fabricate a type, but also did not explicitly record type or explicitly mark message.type as unavailable/absent—only said it wasn't visible. Partial credit for restraint, not full.

criteria.criterion: Report complete ordered author list from message.author
criteria.final_justification: The task requires listing every author from message.author; agent provided none and did not explicitly report that message.author is empty/absent—only that it wasn't visible. Provide partial credit for not fabricating authors, but major missing required deliverable prevents high score.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording the requested fields (stopping condition)
criteria.final_justification: Stopping condition is not met because the agent did not record the requested set of fields (and even missed publisher despite it being visible). Still, it did not add extraneous content. Award partial credit.

limitations: DOM-model evidence cannot prove pixel-only color, styling, geometry, overlap, clipping, z-order, or unrepresented image/canvas/video content. Treat absent content as unproven, not false; source-declared truncation further limits coverage.
